title: Proximity-activated DNA scanning encoded sequencing for massive access to membrane proteins nanoscale organization
boundary: Antibody-linked scanning/barcoding probes activate cyclic nicking cleavage upon proximity; cleaved barcode probes prime strand-displacement amplification and bidirectional extension to produce tandem protein/molecular identifier reporters for NGS. Different molecular recording boundary from Prox-seq ligation or MPX neighborhood pixel association, not an expanded antibody panel.
evidence_scope: Published2025 primary PNAS identity, abstract and Significance preparation overview read in indexed primary text; Methods explicitly points to SI Appendix. SI not opened, exact orderings and full construction uncurated. One published original overview only.

title: Understanding activity-stability tradeoffs in biocatalysts by enzyme proximity sequencing
boundary: Yeast-displayed enzyme variants generate local phenoxyl-radical surface labeling as an activity-dependent fluorescence signal; separate activity and expression sorting followed by variant DNA sequencing links two phenotypes to genotype. Distinct catalytic proximity-label preparation upstream of sorted-library NGS rather than another DMS target panel.
evidence_scope: Published2024 publisher identity/abstract and primaryPMC10902396 overview verified. Direct Nature open redirected to inaccessible identity endpoint; indexed PMC text establishes radical labeling plus sorting/sequencing. No full Methods/SI or oligo curation, no inferred library ends.

title: Multiplexed analysis of fixed tissue RNA using Ligation in situ Hybridization
boundary: Adjacent chimeric RNA-DNA probe pairs hybridize within fixed tissue and are joined by T4 RNA ligase2; RNaseH releases RNA-templated ligation products for amplification and sequencing. RNA-containing probe ligation and enzymatic release distinguish it from all-DNA SplintR HybriSeq, not merely another gene panel.
evidence_scope: Published19June2017 primary OUP identity/abstract and sequencing overview accessible via publisher minimal article. Nanopore-sequencing and ligated-probe readout headings verified; later LISH-LnR imaging successor discovered but not counted separately or substituted. No full curation/oligo transcription.

title: Resolving cellular systems by ultra-sensitive and economical single-cell transcriptome filtering
boundary: Target-specific single-primer linear amplification of captured bead-associated first strands precedes conventional single-cell library preparation; avoids pairing target primers with a universal exponential-amplification primer at this filtering stage. This added linear-selection operation is distinct from DART capture-bead modification or ordinary postlibrary target-panel PCR.
evidence_scope: Published2021 primaryPMC7900351 identity/abstract and Results linear-versus-exponential preparation overview read; publisherPDF title/DOI corroborated. DropSeq and Chromium3primev3 implementations are grouped as one lead; exact selected branch Methods/SI not curated.

title: Genotype-to-Phenotype Mapping of Somatic Clonal Mosaicism via Single-Cell Co-Capture of DNA Mutations and mRNA Transcripts
boundary: Modified two-encapsulation targeted DNA assay adds targeted RNA reverse transcription/capture handles before shared cellular barcoding; streptavidin pulldown physically separates barcoded DNA and RNA amplicons for independent libraries. Joint DNA/RNA preparation and physical separation differ from DNA/protein DAb-seq or simply changing a Tapestri hotspot panel.
evidence_scope: Published primaryPMC12874418 indexed overview and publisher CancerDiscovery identity/title verified, issue2026volume16pp721-739 with late2025online record; direct PMC open challenged. Earlier2024preprint and author code were identified during identity sorting and superseded by published source; no version equivalence or preprint-only recipe adopted. Full Methods/SI uncurated.

title: RoCK and ROI: single-cell transcriptomics with multiplexed enrichment of selected transcripts and region-specific sequencing
boundary: BD Rhapsody bead oligos receive splint-mediated ligation of target capture sequences; protective/splint oligos are removed with lambda exonuclease. Separate ROI selective-priming branch directs reads internally while retaining ordinary transcriptome output. Actual bead transformation/removal and ROI priming distinguish it from panel-only enrichment; compare to DART locally before modeling.
evidence_scope: Published10December2025 primary publisher identity/abstract/Fig1 bead-modification overview and splint/lambda-exonuclease explanation accessible. Author institution mirrors same publishedPDF; linked protocols.io v1 identity noted but not read. One lead for RoCKseq and ROI complementary branches; exact vendor bead revision and full oligos remain for curation.

title: Simultaneous capture of single cell RNA-seq, ATAC-seq, and CRISPR perturbation enables multiomic screens to identify gene regulatory relationships
boundary: A guide-specific RT primer and preannealed splint connect gRNA cDNA to the Multiome ATAC-capture bead arm; ATAC ligation precedes higher-temperature RNA RT and uses Hi-T4 ligase, followed by separate gRNA/RNA/ATAC libraries. Changed primer-splint substrate and operation order preserve ATAC capture, beyond adding another guide panel to Multiome or Spear-ATAC.
evidence_scope: Published10November2025 primary CellReportsMethods DOI/title/summary and primaryPMC12859477 Results/Fig1 guide-capture overview verified.
